Comprehensive Intelligence for Mission-Critical Teams 

With a combination of superior data, curated intelligence, technology, and community, Flashpoint’s threat intelligence platform is trusted by the world’s largest businesses and governments so they can better protect people, places, and assets. 

Get a Demo 

THE BEST DATA FOR THREAT INTELLIGENCE 

Why Choose Flashpoint 

Why choose Flashpoint over other threat intelligence companies ? Flashpoint is the industry leader in threat data and intelligence. We enable mission-critical organizations worldwide to proactively and decisively confront security challenges with the most powerful data at the core. 

Superior Scale and Relevance 

The most timely and impactful intelligence driven by the broadest and deepest collection of data. 

Unmatched Speed and Agility 

Stay ahead of evolving adversary tactics by gaining rapid access to new sources. 

Powerful Technology Combined with Human Collaboration 

Save time and money and maximize your team’s efficiency with intuitive technology and collaborative expertise.

Explore Flashpoint Integrations 

How Flashpoint Enriches the Intelligence Lifecycle 

Analysis & Production 

We provide personalization, AI integrations, and cutting-edge, written research from our team of experts. 

Processing 

We make the data analysis-ready by applying Optical Character Recognition (OCR), geospatial enrichments, and machine-learning tags. 

Collection 

We focus on primary source collections to ensure reliability and relevance. 

Dissemination & Feedback 

We have a direct feedback line with sophisticated customers and enable new source requests in-platform. 

Planning & Direction 

Our Automated Source Discovery technology enables us to discover and rapidly add new sources at scale. 

What We Offer
